_doc: Golden fixture from fixtures/reference-tours/02-ile-de-la-cite-notre-dame.md, loaded by scripts/human_reference_tours.py (composed 2026-04-26). Resolved against live Paris Neo4j 2026-04-29.
_resolution_method: Tag -> beat resolution re-runs the fixture's own script_body method against data/paris/beats.json, exact-first: (1) the tag name is the tail of exactly one corpus beat_id; (2) the quoted paragraph is a verbatim prefix of exactly one beat's script_body (not used for paragraphs carrying more than one tag, where the prose blends beats); (3) the machine-similarity resolution recovered from git 4ea26683, only where it names an existing beat and the two recovered runs agree. Ids are the durable corpus slugs (b.beat_id / stable_beat_id), never the per-database UUIDs minted at upload. Anything still unresolved is listed in unresolved_tags for human review and is deliberately absent from expected_stable_beat_ids.

POIs the 90-minute corridor no longer se.reason: Design §1.1 truth 1 ('standing still is most of the day') and the visit-time model price Notre-Dame's interior plus its 40-minute line at most of the 90 minutes, so this corridor now seats TWO places (Pont Neuf, Notre-Dame) rather than eight brief exteriors. Audit B §1.4 predicted exactly this ('the same corridor seats FEWER, LONGER places ... the loss is one-directional'). The beats are unreachable because the DAY does not go to their POIs, not because the engine chose not to speak them. Restore any of these to the pinned list only if the day seats their POI again.

Place Dauphine (POI walk_by_only).reason: POI poi_role='walk_by_only'; selection.py filters these out at envelope step. Re-tag to 'stop' in Phase 5/6 if Place Dauphine should re-enter the routing layer.

Memorial des Martyrs (POI walk_by_only).reason: POI poi_role='walk_by_only'; would surface via endpoint-pull if upgraded to 'stop'. Polygon hygiene + role re-tagging is in the deferred backlog.

Tour de l'Horloge (separate walk_by_only.reason: RG:tour_horloge content lives on a separate POI 'Tour de l'Horloge' (poi_role='walk_by_only'). Excluded from fixture.

Transits (narrative_function='transition.reason: beat_select narrative_function strategy puts transitions in the 'leftover' bucket; trimmed at DEFAULT_FLAT_MAX=6. Generation will fall back to GLUE_NAV. Algorithm-shape gap (transit branch in beat_select), not a Phase 4 calibration knob.

Notre-Dame no_loc beats (sub_location st.reason: Notre-Dame's 28 no-sub_location beats compete for ONE closing slot under sub_location strategy. Algorithm-shape gap (multi-beat closing pool), not a calibration knob.

Notre-Dame sub_loc duplicates (one beat.reason: _order_by_sub_location picks the highest-scoring beat per sub_loc bucket. Empirical walks include 2-3 beats at facade, central-portal, interior-nave, exterior-east-end. Algorithm-shape gap.

Conciergerie sub_loc duplicates.reason: Same as Notre-Dame: tour-bonbec has 2 beats, rue-de-paris-cells has 2 (climax + callback). One per sub_loc.

Conciergerie no_loc closing.reason: Conciergerie has ~8 no_loc beats competing for the single closing slot under sub_location strategy. Longest wins; this beat loses.

Sainte-Chapelle narrative_function (Phas.reason: Recovered by Phase 4 DEFAULT_FLAT_MAX bump 6→8. No longer unreachable.

Île de la Cité narrative_function (Phase.reason: Recovered by Phase 4 DEFAULT_FLAT_MAX bump 6→8. No longer unreachable.

Vert-Galant pause-tier (Phase 4 recovere.reason: Recovered by Phase 4 PAUSE_BEATS_MAX bump 2→3. No longer unreachable.

Pont Neuf vert-galant climax (narrative_.reason: RECOVERED at W8.6 (2026-08-24): with the corridor seating two places rather than eight, Pont Neuf is no longer competing for a top-6 slot against six other stops' worth of material, and the climax beat is emitted. Moved back into expected_stable_beat_ids.

Crypte vs Palais de Justice (selection s.reason: Crypte (t3, 4 beats) loses to Palais de Justice (t4, 3 beats) under tier × log(1+n) scoring (4.83 vs 5.55). Tried (1+n)^1.3 — flips Crypte/Palais but pulls Notre-Dame too early in greedy and drops Conciergerie/Hôtel-Dieu/Vert-Galant. Tier weighting needs to soften (or richness exponent paired with route-cost rebalance) — out of Phase 4 strict tunables. Phase 5 calibration target.

notes: One-way 90min from Pont Neuf metro; spine Area is Île de la Cité (Phase 2.6 district-dominance rule).

max_anchors=9; algorithm picks 8 stops + endpoint-pull: Pont Neuf → Vert-Galant → Sainte-Chapelle → Conciergerie → Île de la Cité → Crypte → Hôtel-Dieu → Notre-Dame, with 9th slot from endpoint-pull (typically Hôtel de Ville).
Place Dauphine and Mémorial are excluded — both poi_role='walk_by_only'. Polygon/role fixes scheduled before Phase 5.
Conciergerie is the dense building walk; sub_location strategy emits ~7 beats. Notre-Dame is the deepest building walk; sub_location strategy emits ~17 beats.
